name: MuslimInk
author: fiqsr
changelog_id: Dukungan Penuh OTA Update Mandiri: Mengompresi paket secara lossless menjadi 251 KB (<= 256 KB) sehingga file update dapat ditulis langsung oleh firmware ke penyimpanan
Unduhan Otomatis Tersimpan: Berkas unduhan kini langsung muncul di XTApps/muslimink/files/muslimink_update.xtapp dan siap diinstal
Perbaikan Tampilan Kutipan Lockscreen: Ayat dan hadist panjang tidak lagi terpotong di bagian bawah berkat perluasan ruang vertikal (+70px)
Seluruh Fitur 100% Utuh: 514 kota Indonesia, 99 kota dunia, 38 provinsi kiblat, 10 doa harian, 8 tasbih digital, dan 6 gaya jam TrueType tetap lengkap tanpa pemangkasan data
changelog_en: Full Native In-App OTA Update Support: Losslessly slimmed package to 251 KB (<= 256 KB) so firmware single-write limit is never exceeded
Verified Automatic Update Storage: Downloaded packages are saved directly to XTApps/muslimink/files/muslimink_update.xtapp and verified on disk
Lockscreen Multi-Line Quote Fix: Long verses and hadith no longer cut off thanks to expanded vertical budget (+70px clean area)
All 6 Features 100% Preserved: 514 Indonesian cities, 99 world cities, 38 Qibla provinces, 10 duas, 8 dhikr presets, and 6 TrueType clock styles fully intact
